title: Original VIEW/UCS target providers and DXF flag-domain compatibility

sources.role: VIEW scalar, flag and reference roles, group72 UCS gating, named/base UCS absence rules and background/live-section/visual-style/sun handle roles. These format definitions do not independently prove native application loading.

UCS flag bits16/32/64, full axes/origin, repeated71/13/23/33 orthographic option tuples and conditional346 base-UCS carrier. The always0 description of79 and conditional nonzero paragraph are retained as a native/corpus qualification limit.

scope: Actual original opt-in VIEW/UCS source/typed publications, immutable original state/model/raw/context snapshots, shared bounded production/replay grammar, separate original field/reference inventory and physical TABLES origin binding. Selected original LAYOUT active view-name/UCS handle targets can join. No recursive/live/emitted/native/external gate promotion.

implementation.publication: Separate DRW_DxfViewUcsSourceHandler facet and borrowed getDxfViewUcsSourceView; actual source/typed pointers and original pre-staging common state. Table selection is latched. RAII expires pointers on return or throw; false clears the view elsewhere. Legacy resource kinds1..8 and plot-source view remain unchanged. No DRW_Interface pure virtual, installed model/facade data member or existing vtable slot changes.
implementation.grammar: Existing UCS repeated tuple grammar is shared with bounded replay. Original raw source is captured only for opted-in consumers, using whole application-group capture. Normal callbacks retain their established staged order. DXF flags accept VIEW0x71/UCS0x70; native no-arg payload validators retain VIEW0x51/UCS0x50.
implementation.sources: Immutable independently pinned source-phase model/raw/common-state and read context are paired to the actual typed callback. Exact shared replay compares all modeled fields and handles. Independent subclass/scalar/reference inventories refuse unsupported fields, duplicate scalars, incomplete coordinates/options, unknown scopes and unsupported mode combinations.
implementation.origins: Bind original symbol-table record and actual original table control, TABLES section and physical owner. Census all physical VIEW/UCS rows; missing/dropped/unknown providers cannot supply complete namespaces. ASCII case aliases are accepted against canonical expected keywords.
implementation.dependencies: Add selected original VIEW/UCS nodes and original common/XDATA/named/base-UCS references. LAYOUT active plot-view name resolves only through the full original VIEW census with conservative name spelling/ambiguity rules; UCS handles require actual original UCS providers. Background/live-section/sun semantics and VisualStyle/RenderSettings source providers remain unqualified.
implementation.bounds: Charge retained models/raw/groups/reference profiles/context/audit state and bounded replay work before allocations. Check all reader budget verdicts. Queries allocate no memory. Record/group/byte/work caps are unchanged; failures remain separate from ordinary parser acceptance.

captureOffsets.note: Typed failure scope isolates the actual observer from later legacy live-container allocations.

controls.fixturePolicy: All new drawings are authored at runtime from C++ recipes; no external DWG/DXF payload, conversion or derivative is committed.

retainedFailures: Initial core compile failed because a contextless patch added a UCS overload declaration in DRW_Group. Corrected with class-anchored patch; no Group change remains.
Expanded fixture initially expected ordinary acceptance for UCS345, but existing DXF validation correctly refuses the DWG-only named-UCS member. Mark the parser-refusal witness explicitly.
Initial output recipe omitted the UCS handle required by existing graph preflight; supply valid authored identities.
Armed whole typed callback reached later live-container retention, which is separate from original-source audit. Isolate the actual typed observer to qualify its failures precisely.

A mixed-case keyword witness exposed new origin comparison passing a noncanonical expected keyword to asciiIdentifierEquals. Compare against canonical VIEW/UCS constants; do not broaden global identifier behavior.

First wider final cohort passes88/89: an existing VPORT ambient CMC test searches for a named first row even though writeVport emits that row as *ACTIVE. An isolated ASCII/binary probe confirms preserved color and emitted name; writer and failing recipe spans are byte-identical to HEAD. Correct the recipe by preceding the named witness with an active row and add named physical-output/readback assertions; retain metadata and destination refusal checks. No VPORT production behavior changes.
